labels.dataset: MIRCA-OS crop calendars (harvested area per unit, crop and water system)
labels.citation: Kebede, E. A. et al. (2025). A global open-source dataset of monthly irrigated and rainfed cropped areas (MIRCA-OS) for the 21st century. Scientific Data 12, 208.

inputs.site: MODIS MCD12Q1 v061 LC_Type1 2015, cropland pixel nearest the unit centre (ORNL DAAC subset API)
inputs.temperature: NASA POWER daily T2M, T2M_MAX, T2M_MIN (MERRA-2), 2001-2020, monthly means, lapse-adjusted from the cell to the site elevation
inputs.rain: GPCC Full Data Monthly v2025, 0.5° (NOAA PSL THREDDS), 2001-2020; NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR where GPCC has no value
inputs.rainPower: NASA POWER PRECTOTCORR (MERRA-2, bias-corrected), monthly totals: second rainfall series for the sensitivity run
inputs.soil: ISRIC SoilGrids 2.0, 0-30 cm depth-weighted means (pH, organic carbon, clay, sand, CEC)

design.present: harvested area in the water system >= 1 % of the unit's harvested area and >= 100 ha
design.rainfedNegative: no rainfed area of the crop in the unit: "absent" (not grown at all) or "irrigated-only" (grown, but only with irrigation)
design.irrigatedNegative: crop not grown at all in a unit that irrigates >= 5 % of its harvested area and >= 1000 ha
design.excluded: trace areas between zero and the presence threshold; irrigated questions in units without irrigation
design.score: best sowing month, rainfed or full irrigation; slope is not scored (no single slope for a unit)
design.selectionRule: higher ROC-AUC on the curated crop classes, both water systems pooled

Oceania.note: fewer than 5 cases in one class

Cocoa.note: fewer than 5 cases in one class

rainFromNasaPower.note: curated classes, rainfall from NASA POWER (MERRA-2) instead of GPCC

cropland-mosaic.note: fewer than 5 cases in one class

calendar.note: annual curated and raw crops a unit grows; seasons with >= 20 % of the crop's area; rates are over the cases the method itself rates suitable

multipleCropping.note: rice, CropSuite only, units where CropSuite rates rice at least moderately suitable
